note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), the original being in English; synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records not translated, and the measurements of wing membrane papillae and microstars are recorded as given.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; antennae, labrum, legs and body white; mandibles dark brown, base paler. Head capsule rather hairy, body densely hairy. Body length about 5.9 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, flat, longer than wide (to mandibular base 2.0, greatest width 1.2 mm); sides nearly straight, posteriorly slightly narrowed to a rounded posterior margin. Fontanelle indistinct, eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus flat, hairy (length 0.15, width 0.57 mm); anteclypeus narrow, band-like, hairless. Labrum subtriangular (length 0.20, width 0.27 mm). Mandibles stout, base broad, length 0.83–0.87 mm; left mandible with a tooth at about the apical quarter, right mandible with a distinct tooth slightly below the apical third. Postmentum long, rod-shaped, widest at the apical third, narrowest slightly below the middle; length 1.23, greatest width 0.33, minimum waist width 0.20 mm. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped; length 0.33, greatest width 0.70 mm; anterior and posterior margins without notches. Legs and abdomen as in the genus; cerci 0.08 mm long.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule, postclypeus and antennae pale yellow; thorax and legs milky white; abdominal tergites transparent, greyish from intestinal contents. Head rather hairy, body densely hairy. Body length 4.1–4.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (to mandibular base 0.70–0.77, greatest width 0.87–0.90 mm). Fontanelle semitransparent, circular, situated dorsally on the middle of the vertex (0.10–0.13 mm in diameter). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Clypeus, labrum and mandibles as in the genus; postclypeus length 0.23–0.27, width 0.40–0.43 mm; labrum length 0.27–0.33, width 0.37–0.40 mm. Pronotum as in the soldier (length 0.23–0.27, greatest width 0.50–0.53 mm). Legs as in the soldier, fore legs stouter. Abdomen elongate-oval, narrowing posteriorly; cerci 0.07 mm long.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule blackish brown; postclypeus and pronotum dark brown; abdominal dorsum dark brown, venter pale brown; antennae and legs brown; wings brown. Head and body covered with a thick layer of fine hairs and a few long hairs. Body length with wings 11.2–12.8, without wings 6.5–8.00 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long including eyes (to mandibular base 0.77–0.93, width including eyes 1.07–1.13 mm). Fontanelle small, circular, white and dot-like, situated dorsally on the middle of the vertex (0.03–0.06 mm in diameter). Compound eyes circular, 0.27–0.30 mm in diameter. Ocelli oval, semitransparent, maximum diameter 0.10–0.13, minimum diameter 0.09–0.10 mm, at about half the maximum diameter to slightly more from the compound eye, but less than the short diameter. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest and narrowest. Postclypeus inflated, hairy; anterior margin nearly straight or slightly convex; about half as long as wide (length 0.23–0.25, width 0.47–0.50 mm). Anteclypeus hairless, flat, anterior margin slightly projecting in the middle. Labrum broadly ligulate, anterior part and body hairy (length 0.30–0.33, width 0.37–0.41 mm). Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head; anterior margin slightly incurved, posterior margin also slightly incurved; length 0.6–0.7, width 0.90–0.97 mm. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum deeply concave. Legs as in the genus. Wings brown, margins hairy; fore wing membrane moderately hairy, hind wing membrane hairless; fore wing without scales 9.1–10.1, hind wing 8.4–9.5 mm; anterior margin with 1–2 rows of spinous papillae (6 × 3 μm), posterior margin with one row of smaller papillae (4–5 × 1–2 μm), membrane covered with non-stellate 2- to 4-pronged microstars (4–8 × 4–6 μm, density 9280/mm²); fore wing media with 2–4, cubitus with 10–13 branches, hind wing media with 2–3, cubitus with 9–12 branches. Abdomen elongate-oval, densely hairy; cerci 0.07–0.10 mm, 2-segmented; styli absent.
